name: Your First Chord: D
instructions: The D chord uses three fingers on the top three strings (D, G, B) -- take it slow and check each string rings out clearly.
Press just behind the fret, not directly on top of it, for the cleanest sound with the least effort.
Strum only the bottom four strings (D-G-B-E) for this chord -- the low E and A strings are not part of it.
Watch today's video for a clear walkthrough of the D chord shape.
